name: producer_minimal_payloadless
documented_rejection: Envelope satisfies the EventEnvelope required set (12 tokens) and actor.id but carries neither payload nor payload_ref. ValidateBasic rejects the both-absent case with ErrInvalid; statusForError maps ErrInvalid to HTTP 400 and errorBody to code invalid_request. This is deliberately 400, NOT 422: the runtime reserves 422 for schema_not_found, tenant_mismatch and occurred_at_out_of_range (statusForError sentinel precedence). A producer building to the fixed spec must supply payload or payload_ref even though all other required tokens are present.

name: tenant_mismatch_contrast
documented_rejection: Validated-conforming envelope (carries payload) with a non-empty tenant_id that differs from the server-resolved tenant (the bearer dev:tenant-a:service:sverp-web resolves tenant-a). ValidateBasic passes; Ingest then rejects with ErrTenantMismatch (DS-08): HTTP 422, error.code tenant_mismatch. An empty or absent tenant_id is derived from the client/source registration and stamped by the server — mismatch rejection requires a non-empty differing value.

name: occurred_at_out_of_range_contrast
documented_rejection: Same shape as producer_minimal_payloadless but occurred_at is year 2300, outside the ledger horizon [1900-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2299-12-31T23:59:59.999Z]. ValidateBasic rejects with ErrOccurredAtOutOfRange (which wraps ErrInvalid); statusForError matches the sentinel before ErrInvalid, so the HTTP status is 422 (not 400) with error.code occurred_at_out_of_range.
